name: What costs are involved when exiting a rental property?

mainEntity.name: What costs are involved when exiting a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exiting a rental property involves various costs such as realtor commissions, closing costs, potential repairs or renovations to prepare the property for sale, and possibly eviction costs if tenants need to be removed. Property taxes and any outstanding mortgage balances will also be settled at closing. Understanding these costs upfront is crucial for accurately calculating your net proceeds, especially in competitive markets like Aventura or Boca Raton where preparation can be key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs include commissions, closing costs, repairs, and potential eviction, all impacting your net proceeds.
